text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that stopping be prohibited at all times on the east and west sides of Waverley Road, between Kewbeach Avenue and a point 15 metres further north, and on the north and south sides of Kewbeach Avenue, between Waverley Road and a point 15 metres west. These proposed changes will deter parking at these locations, and improve safety for pedestrians and motorists traveling within the bend in the roadway where Waverley Road and Kewbeach Avenue intersect.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Prohibited stopping at all times on the east and west sides of Waverley Road, between Kewbeach Avenue and a point 15 metres north. 2. Prohibited stopping at all times on north and south sides of Kewbeach Avenue, between Waverley Road and point 15 metres west.
